budget_items.topic: Attorney contract for cable license renewal
budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager told a member she has the proposed contract from the attorney but has not had time to review it yet, so no action was needed at this meeting.

budget_items.topic: PEG/local access fee on cable bills
budget_items.what_was_said: A member noted the public access committee gets a share of subscriber bills as a line item added by Comcast, and wondered how much impact that has and how billing works.
A member said there is a current side letter giving senior citizens a small discount, raised as possible leverage for services like Wi-Fi in the next agreement.
A member said the public access committee is beginning to look at what equipment it has and what it would need to purchase going forward.

decisions.decision: The ascertainment process for the Comcast license renewal must be completed by February 28, 2027.
Brian V will tour the cable operator's technical facilities and the PEG access studio.
A member will research what other communities' cable agreements include, using outreach calls and AI tools as a starting point.
Karen will lead outreach to town departments; the chair will handle the library; Tom will handle the school district.
Tom will contact the school district through the superintendent first, then the IT staff.
Karen will check with the town whether Comcast complaint records exist, including checking the town manager's and select board's offices.
A member will try to find a map of the Comcast service area, checking with the state or Comcast.
Brian L, though absent, will be asked to review the license and other circulated documents.
The public hearing and municipal-wide survey will be held off until more preliminary information is gathered from town departments.
The committee tentatively targeted Tuesday, October 13 or Tuesday, October 20 for its next meeting, pending the attorney; minutes will list the date as 'October Tuesday TBA.'
Brian V, as secretary, will send approved minutes as a PDF to the town clerk going forward.
The chair will hold off on drafting the next agenda until there is word on the attorney/legal contract.

what_happened.line: The Cable Advisory Committee opened its review of Comcast's license renewal, working against a February 2027 deadline for the required ascertainment process.
The committee put off the public hearing and a townwide survey until legal counsel is retained and more information comes back from town departments.
Members split up outreach tasks: contacting town departments, the library and the schools, touring cable facilities, and researching other towns' recent contracts.
The town manager has a draft attorney contract for the renewal but had not yet reviewed it as of this meeting.
The committee tentatively set its next meeting for a Tuesday in October, pending word on the attorney.

why_it_matters: This process sets the terms of the town's next cable contract with Comcast, including funding for public access programming and any resident discounts or services negotiated into it.
Residents will eventually be asked to weigh in through a public hearing and a survey, but neither has a date yet.
No money or contract terms have been decided; this stage is fact-finding ahead of hiring counsel.
